page: Amazon Web Services m1.small is a first-generation general-purpose server instance. It features a single dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2651 v2 physical core running at 1.8 GHz on the legacy i386 32-bit architecture. The instance is provisioned with 2.0 GB of system memory, yielding 1.7 GB of RAM per core, and is managed via the Xen hypervisor. It includes 160 GB of local HDD storage, but lacks any GPU acceleration or baseline network bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks place this instance consistently in the bottom 10% across all tested categories. The single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU benchmarks both score 969.19, reflecting the single-threaded, single-core hardware limitation. Memory bandwidth is limited, with large-block read speeds at 8.16 GB/sec and write speeds at 6.94 GB/sec. Cryptographic operations benefit from hardware AES support, but the CPU lacks modern instruction sets such as AVX, AVX-512, and AMX.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this legacy instance provides a low-resource entry point but offers very low performance density compared to modern hardware classes. It is best suited for legacy 32-bit applications, basic testing, or low-traffic static web serving that requires dedicated CPU allocation but minimal processing power.
description: Amazon Web Services m1.small is a first-generation general-purpose instance designed for legacy workloads. It features a single dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2651 v2 core running at 1.8 GHz on the 32-bit i386 architecture, paired with 2.0 GB of system memory and 160 GB of local HDD storage. Operating under the Xen hypervisor, the instance lacks modern CPU instruction sets like AVX and has a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps. Benchmark results place its CPU and memory performance in the bottom 10% of tested servers, with a Geekbench single-core score of 490.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 949.92. Given its low resource density and legacy architecture, this instance is best suited for basic utility tasks, legacy 32-bit software testing, or low-traffic static web serving.
